Package io.webagent4j.workflow

Record Class WorkflowResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.webagent4j.workflow.WorkflowResult
Record Components:
workflowId - the executed workflow's identifier
status - the overall terminal outcome
steps - every step's result, in workflow definition order
failure - the overall failure, present exactly when status is WorkflowStatus.FAILED
public record WorkflowResult(WorkflowId workflowId, WorkflowStatus status, List<WorkflowStepResult> steps, WorkflowOutputs outputs, Optional<WorkflowFailure> failure) extends Record
Immutable, structured outcome of one WorkflowEngine.execute(Workflow, WorkflowInputs) call.

Secret safety: toString() always masks every output declared WorkflowVariable.secret(). output(WorkflowVariable) is explicit typed retrieval and intentionally returns the real value even for a secret output - the same explicit-read-vs- incidental-rendering boundary described on IWorkflowVariables.
